name: One World Lithium Inc.
summary: One World Lithium Inc. focuses on the acquisition, exploration, and development of lithium resource properties in Canada. It engages in the lithium separation extraction technology business. The company was formerly known as One World Minerals Inc. and changed its name to One World Lithium Inc. in January 2018. One World Lithium Inc. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
